SELECT p.product_id, p.item_name, p.view_count, p.category, ph.avg_price, ph.region, ph.date, ph.change_rate FROM product p JOIN price_history ph ON p.product_id = ph.product_id WHERE ph.region = #{region} AND ph.date >= #{startDate}
AND p.item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword} '%')
ORDER BY p.view_count DESC
ORDER BY ph.date DESC
ORDER BY ph.date DESC
